'''Nylite solutions''' were used in the construction of materials during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and the [[Galactic War]]. It was fatal when consumed by almost all [[Species/Legends|species]], except for [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]].
